stem: Which cranial nerve lies freely within the cavernous sinus alongside the internal carotid artery?
answer_explanation: The abducens nerve (CN VI) runs within the cavernous sinus next to the internal carotid artery; CN III, IV, V1 and V2 are in the lateral wall.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Anatomy; Topic: Cavernous sinus. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: An upper trunk brachial plexus injury causing Erb palsy most commonly involves which roots?
